text: single effect regression (SER) model Bayesian   multiple regression model single candidate   variable active (“included”). Therefore,   posterior distribution becomes “mixture” simpler   single-variable regression models. first element SER model multiple regression   model outcome y,   $$y = Xb + e,$$   \(e\) vector independent, normally   distributed error terms, \(e \sim N(0, \sigma^2 )\).   residual variance \(\sigma^2\) assumed known. second element SER model SER prior   coefficients vector \(b\). SER prior   property \(b\) drawn prior exactly   one nonzero coefficient. example, SER model initialized   init_ser_model_normal() defines prior   coefficient \(j\) nonzero prior probability   \(\pi_j\), nonzero coefficient assigned normal   prior zero mean variance \(\sigma_0^2\) may   estimated. SER posterior reduces mixture   single-variable regression models, sufficient statistics   needed compute posterior sufficient   statistics needed compute posterior   single-variable model, least-squares estimate   coefficient variance. key steps analysis single effect regression :   () prepare data using prepare_ser_data function;   (ii) initialize SER model using init_ser_data   function; (iii) fit model compute posterior   statistics fitted model using fit_ser_data   function.
